about: healthchecks c41796e4: new sendflappingnotices command (hc.accounts) emails owners of checks with over 200 flips in 24 hours through the new hc.lib.emails.flapping_notice; the loop reads check.project.owner.email on a queryset fetched with .only('name') and no select_related, so it lazily loads the project and the owner for every check (a query in a loop with no explicit query call), while the email helper it calls runs no query
